extensionAttribute.description: Reports Time Machine configuration status ("Enabled" or "Disabled").
extensionAttribute.scriptContentsMac:
#!/bin/zsh
# Updated by SecurityShrimp 2026 # Time Machine Status Extension Attribute # Targets macOS 12 through 26 (Tahoe), Intel and Apple Silicon
state=$(/usr/bin/defaults read /Library/Preferences/com.apple.TimeMachine AutoBackup 2>/dev/null)
if [[ "$state" == "1" ]]; then echo "<result>Enabled</result>" else echo "<result>Disabled</result>" fi
